elevenlabsPrompt:
[intrigued] Can't reach the top of your iPhone with one thumb?

[confident] Here's the fix. Turn on Reachability.

[friendly] Open Settings, Accessibility, then Touch. Switch on Reachability. Swipe down on the bar at the bottom.

[delighted] The top half of the screen drops right under your thumb.

[warm] One tech tip a day, at techtipaday dot com.
